rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for speaking in an angry, indignant manner.

example.english: They indignantly scolded people as soon as they heard the news.
example.traditional: 佢一聽到呢個消息，就嬲嬲哋咁鬧人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 zau6 nau1 nau1 dei6 gam3 naau6 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the indignation specifically comes from feeling that something is unfair or unacceptable.

example.english: They indignantly argued with the staff after seeing someone cut in line.
example.traditional: 見到人哋插隊，佢好唔忿氣咁同職員理論。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 jan4 dei6 caap3 deoi2 keoi5 hou2 m4 fan6 hei3 gam3 tung4 zik1 jyun4 lei5 leon6
